answer: Audits are logged in zephyr, queued in vertex, and gale publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 42 identities per epoch. A farm of 363 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1131 identities would post 2938 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
